text:
Sending money from one Shoprite or Checkers counter to another costs a flat R9.99 on top of the money you send. Flat means the same fee whether you send a little or a lot: on R200 it's about 5%, on R2,000 only about 0.5%. Lerato (an illustration) sends her mother R200 four times a month: four fees, almost R40. One R800 transfer a month costs one fee, about R10. That's about R30 a month, or about R360 a year, back in her pocket for the same money sent.

About the example: 4 x R9.99 = R39.96 a month; 1 x R9.99 = R9.99; the difference is R29.97 a month, R359.64 a year.

Full story: "How Shoprite Makes Money: R6 of Every R100 (and Why It's in Every Town)" on the Money From Zero channel.
